questions.question: Euclid's Division Lemma: a = bq + r mein r ki range?
questions.explanation: Remainder hamesha 0 se divisor-1 tak hota hai.

questions.question: √5 ek rational number hai.
questions.explanation: √5 irrational hai — proof by contradiction se sabit hota hai.

questions.question: Agar HCF(a,b)=6 aur a×b=108, to LCM kya hoga?
Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic sirf prime numbers par apply hota hai.
questions.explanation: Ye composite numbers ke prime factorization par apply hota hai.

questions.question: Do numbers ka HCF × LCM kis ke barabar hota hai?
questions.explanation: HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers.

questions.question: π (pi) kaisa number hai?
questions.explanation: π ka decimal na terminate karta hai na repeat — ye irrational hai.
